origin: Own exact centered four-channel Gaussian population model for partially overlapping scientific sensor campaigns. These are stipulated population moments, not sample covariance estimates; no sampling interval, empirical graphical discovery or data-imputation accuracy is implied.
observed_constraints: A single centered jointly Gaussian vector X=(X1,X2,X3,X4) has all four variances1. Overlapping campaigns identify Cov12=Cov23=Cov34=Cov41=3/5 exactly. Opposite pairs13 and24 are never jointly measured, so x=Cov13 and y=Cov24 are unknown, not zero. Preserve variable identities and symmetry. The scientifically compatible class is ALL positive SEMIDEFINITE4x4covariance completions with those observed entries, including singular Gaussian laws. No stationarity, exchange symmetry, graphical sparsity or conditional independence is an extra empirical constraint. You may exploit symmetry of the feasible SET/objective to optimize, but may not impose x=y on the full uncertainty class.
completion_problem: Derive a necessary AND sufficient description of the entire feasible(x,y)region, with every equality/rank boundary and sharp individual coordinate intervals. Report the product bound in the equivalent representation(1+x)(1+y)>=k alongside the required coordinate bounds. Decide whether the separate marginal coordinate intervals suffice. Retain the complete registered symmetric eigendecomposition of the zero-filled candidate, not merely a determinant or diagonal check. Explain why positive semidefinite is essential even though every individually measured2x2pair is valid.
entropy_model: Among strictly positive definite completions, choose the Gaussian with maximum differential entropy, equivalently maximum logdet. Prove global uniqueness in the full two-parameter class using concavity and a valid interior optimality certificate; do not assume x=y without justification. Derive a finite stationarity polynomial and retain its complete registered root inventory, rejecting every inadmissible stationary branch. Retain the complete registered eigendecomposition and actual full registered inverse of the selected4x4covariance. Report the full covariance, full precision and logdet. Determine which missing-pair conditional independences this chosen Gaussian has and whether the observations identify them for EVERY compatible Gaussian. A maximum entropy convention is not proof that missing covariances are zero or that physical channels have no causal influence.
sharp_scientific_bounds: For the contrast D=X1-X3 and the different contrast L=X1+X3-2X2-2X4, find SHARP lower and upper variances over the entire PSD completion class. Report the completing(x,y)at both L extrema and the ranks of those full matrices. Obtain the exact range of P(|L|>1) using Gaussian laws, including correct treatment of singular endpoints. Retain full registered symmetric eigendecompositions at BOTH L-extremal completions and actual registered products of each complete covariance with the whole contrast column(1,-2,1,-2); use the actual returned vectors for the variances. Use a registered standard normal distribution call for the complete required tail probabilities with input/operation order retained. Prove globality and attainment over the continuum, not a grid of completions. State whether the numerical extrema remain attained if the class is instead strictly positive definite.
prediction_and_robustness: Predict X1 from simultaneously observed(X2,X4)using a fixed linear predictor w2*X2+w4*X4, with no intercept because means are known zero. First obtain the squared-error-optimal predictor under the selected maximum entropy Gaussian using an ACTUAL full registered2x2linear-system solve and retain its entire output. Then compute its worst-case population MSE over ALL PSD-compatible completions. Finally solve min over ALL REAL(w2,w4)of max over ALL compatible covariances E[(X1-w2X2-w4X4)^2]. Give the COMPLETE minimax weight set as a closed line segment with both endpoints, decide whether it is unique, and select the minimum Euclidean norm member only as a documented tie-break. Prove no weights outside the reported set attain the optimum, and prove each point inside it does attain the same global risk. A symmetric minimizer alone is not the full answer. Report the worst-case y for the minimum-norm member. Use actual registered matrix multiplication to propagate both the maxent predictor and minimum-norm minimax predictor through the extremal observed2x2covariance when validating their worst risks; do not invert a singular observed covariance.

interpretation_proposals.A: Individually valid pairwise correlations can be incompatible with a proposed full covariance completion.
interpretation_proposals.B: A never-observed covariance is identified as zero by absence of a joint campaign.
interpretation_proposals.C: Maximum entropy can select a unique model while the data-compatible covariance class remains a continuum.
interpretation_proposals.D: A unique maximum entropy covariance guarantees its optimal predictor is minimax for every compatible covariance.
interpretation_proposals.E: Singular boundary completions can determine sharp scientific risk bounds, even if they have no full-dimensional Gaussian density.
interpretation_proposals.F: Symmetry of a minimax problem proves the minimax weight vector is unique.
interpretation_proposals.G: A conditional-independence graph inferred from a completion convention proves the absence of physical causal effects.
interpretation_proposals.H: A full minimax solution set and a chosen minimum-norm representative answer different questions.

reporting: Use the public schema; numerical absolute tolerance1e-7. Matrix rows/columns followX1,X2,X3,X4; prediction weights followX2,X4. Missing covariances followx=Cov13,y=Cov24. Every interval is[lower,upper]. Minimax segment endpoints may be exchanged, but their two weight coordinates retain identities. PSD constraints, coordinate bounds and exact ranks/counts/booleans remain strict scientific requirements; tiny eigensolver roundoff at an analytically proven zero eigenvalue is not a negative physical variance. Preserve the full continuous-region, entropy, sharp-bound and complete minimax-set derivations in the trajectory. The normal-tail values concern true population Gaussian contrasts, not a confidence guarantee from finite data.

primary_context.title: On the Geometry of Maximum Entropy Problems
primary_context.role: Primary methodological context for Dempster-style maximum entropy covariance completion. All numerical covariances, contrasts and robust prediction objectives in this task are constructed by this project; no article empirical dataset or prose is reproduced.
